### Checked and confirmed (no change)

- Verb stems the drafter asked about, all correct: mnan past of gnon (gnon/mnan/gnan/non); phab past of 'bebs ('bebs/phab/dbab/phob); btang past of gtong; bzhag past of 'jog (imp. zhog); bos past of 'bod; zhus past of zhu; shar past of 'char; gtad past of gtod; klogs imperative of klog (klog/bklags/bklag/klogs); sgoms imperative of sgom (sgom/bsgoms/bsgom/sgoms); nyon imperative of nyan. Also gdab future of 'debs (u. 4), ngo sprad past of ngo sprod (u. 42), byas past of byed (u. 1).
- ces after final g: units 23, 45, 46 all follow ཅིག / ཤིག — correct; zhes after vowels elsewhere — correct. Imperative particle cig / shig: gtod cig (d), sgoms shig, yengs shig (s) — correct.
- Genitive / instrumental allomorphs in w: ཀུན་ གྱི, ཐོན་ གྱི, འདུལ་ གྱི, བདུན་ གྱི, ཉམས་ལེན་ གྱི (after n/l); རྩ་རླུང་ གི, གོང་ གི, མཆོག་ གི, ཚངས་བུག་ གི (after ng/g); ཚིག་ གིས, ཕལ་པ་ རྣམས་ ཀྱིས (after g/s) — all regular.
- Misprint fixes named in their units in the required form: མཆད (6), ཉམས་ལན (26), མཚན་མཁ་དོག (28), ཤོར་བདང (50). Abbreviations / contractions written out and named: གྶི, ནམཁའ (18), ཅནྡུ, སྒོཾས (45), འདེབྶ (48), དགོསོ (50). Every [?] (re, 11; shig and ལན, 26; sing nga, 29; ཅནྡུ, 45) is called uncertain. The interlinear addition (26) is described.
- Other-recension differences of sense from the log are all mentioned: units 3, 4, 7, 11, 17, 18, 25, 29, 31, 33, 34, 40, 41, 45.
- House renderings: the between / bardo, face-introduce / point out, clear light, reality-itself / reality, body of truth, knowing / awareness, wind, channel — consistent throughout.
- No phrase in i reads as a remembered published translation (no "O nobly born", etc.); the i's are built from the grammar.

### Findings considered and refused

- Division གསལ་གདབ / གསལ་བཏབ / གསལ་འདེབས as one word: kept. The pilot writes གསལ་འདེབས་ as one word (title, u. 1, 19); the verb is lexicalised. Where a negative intervenes it is split (གསལ་ མི་ ཐེབས, u. 48), correctly.
- ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུ, ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་མོ / པོ, འོད་མི་འགྱུར་བ as one word: kept. The pilot keeps names and lexical compounds with an internal particle whole (རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ, དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པ, དེ་མ་ཐག་ཏུ, པདྨ་འབྱུང་གནས).
- ཅི་ནས་ཀྱང one word: kept, like the pilot's གང་ཡང (lexical adverb), while free ཀྱང / ཡང after a word stay separate, as in the draft.
- ཞེས་པའམ one word: kept; -pa is the nominaliser on zhes, and -'am is fused, like the pilot's བླ་མའམ.
- གདོས་བཅས་ཅན་དུ one word: kept; can is a suffix and du follows a single word.
- ཕྱལ་ཆད་དུ attached: kept; du governs the single noun phyal chad (stong pa is the subject).
- ལམ་གྱིས (u. 37, "in a flash", as the pilot's u. 26) vs ལམ་ གྱིས (u. 50, "by the path"): kept. Different words: in u. 50 "in a flash" gives no sense with goms 'dris yod; the note there says so.
- rigs kyi bu in l as "child-of-noble-family" where the pilot's l has "Child of the family": kept, because conventions.md gives "child of noble family" as the house rendering without distinguishing layers; flagged for QUESTIONS.
- klogs te (u. 43): imperative followed by te is unusual, but klogs is the imperative stem and instructional prose runs on this way; label kept.
- mnan no (u. 2) as an instruction in the past stem: the note already says so; kept.
- rang gi thub na (u. 13) read as gi for gis: kept; it is the print's habit the pilot and conventions record (གཅིག་གི for གིས), and the sense is unaffected.
- u. 5 i leaves gcig ("one, a single") unrendered: idiomatic layer; l has it. Kept.
- u. 40 i "hears their crying" for du rgod (prob. ngu rgod "weeping and laughter"): the note says the reading is uncertain and that the translation takes it as crying; kept.
- u. 2 alternative sense (the pressing cuts off the throbbing): chad is intransitive, so "having stopped" is the natural reading; kept, with the guess now flagged.
- u. 15 phog par bya: no stem label given in the note, and "make it land" is a fair rendering; kept.
- u. 36 note "cig is gcig in its softened form": kept; after n the indefinite would be zhig, so this is the numeral gcig without its prefix, as the note says.
- u. 18 thugs bskyed (honorific) in the mouth of bdag: the note already says the formula keeps it; kept.
